description: This file declares the LocalInstanceGroup class which manages groups of local instances, providing methods for creation, deserialization, accessors, and operations related to instance management within a group.

classes.name: LocalInstanceGroup
classes.description: Class managing a group of local instances with methods for creation, modification, and querying.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static method to create a LocalInstanceGroup from a given instance group proto.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Static method to deserialize a LocalInstanceGroup from JSON.

methods.name: const std::string & GroupName() const
methods.description: Returns the name of the instance group.

methods.name: const std::string & HomeDir() const
methods.description: Returns the home directory associated with the group.

methods.name: SetHomeDir
methods.description: Sets the home directory for the group.

methods.name: const std::string & HostArtifactsPath() const
methods.description: Returns the path to host artifacts for the group.

methods.name: SetHostArtifactsPath
methods.description: Sets the host artifacts path.

methods.name: const std::string & ProductOutPath() const
methods.description: Returns the product output path for the group.

methods.name: SetProductOutPath
methods.description: Sets the product output path.

methods.name: StartTime
methods.description: Retrieves the start time of the group.

methods.name: SetStartTime
methods.description: Sets the start time of the group.

methods.name: const std::vector<LocalInstance> & Instances() const
methods.description: Returns a reference to the vector of instances within the group.

methods.name: HasActiveInstances
methods.description: Checks if there are active instances in the group.

methods.name: const cvd::InstanceGroup & Proto() const
methods.description: Returns a constant reference to the underlying proto message.

methods.name: SetAllStates
methods.description: Set the state for all instances within the group.

methods.name: AssemblyDir
methods.description: Returns the directory where assemblies related to the group are stored.

methods.name: FindInstanceById
methods.description: Find an instance in the group by its unique ID.

methods.name: FindByInstanceName
methods.description: Find instances matching a given per-instance name.

methods.name: FetchStatus
methods.description: Fetches status from all instances asynchronously, with a timeout.

methods.name: std::vector<LocalInstance> & Instances()
methods.description: unavailable

ctags.name: GroupName
ctags.pattern: /^  const std::string& GroupName() const { return group_proto_->name(); }$/

ctags.name: HomeDir
ctags.pattern: /^  const std::string& HomeDir() const { return group_proto_->home_directory(); }$/

ctags.name: Instances
ctags.pattern: /^  const std::vector<LocalInstance>& Instances() const { return instances_; }$/
